notes: - The QUIC check now explains itself: what QUIC (HTTP/3) is and who uses it, why it sometimes breaks (ERR_QUIC_PROTOCOL_ERROR), how WinFo tests it, and the common causes - firewalls/UTMs that filter web traffic (SonicWall, FortiGate, Sophos, WatchGuard, Meraki...), VPNs and tunnels that drop full-size packets, security software that inspects web traffic on the PC, and ISP equipment - with what to do about each. Shown on the Network Speed Test page even before a test is run; hover any line for the full text
